descriptionHtml: Embarked on a captivating journey into the cosmos, the unveiling of the wonders of space through an engaging exhibition featuring a picosatellite took place at the IEEE stall of the Open Day event at the University of Peradeniya. This interactive showcase invited students to delve into the world of small-scale satellite technology. Attendees gained insights into the design and components of Pico satellites, exploring the intricacies of satellite engineering, from solar panels to communication systems. The exhibition shed light on the specific mission objectives of the showcased satellite, whether it be Earth observation, scientific research, or technology demonstration. Students engaged in hands-on activities that simulated the challenges faced by satellite engineers, providing a firsthand experience of assembling model satellites. The exhibition also featured real-life success stories of picosatellite missions, and attendees participated in a Q&A session with the presenters. This event served as not only an educational opportunity but also a chance for students to network with the engineering undergraduates of the University of Peradeniya, fostering a deeper understanding of space technology and inspiring the next generation of aerospace enthusiasts. It was a unique chance to unlock the secrets of the cosmos through the lens of Pico satellites.
